_note: Simplified, USDM-inspired subset of the ABC-101 protocol. Amendment 1. Days are counted from the Screening visit (Day 0).

study.title: A Phase 2, Randomized, Double-Blind Study of ABX-17 in Adults with Moderate-to-Severe Plaque Psoriasis

summaryOfChanges.change: Week 4 visit window widened from +/-3 days to +/-5 days to reduce out-of-window visits.
Added EX_03: prior biologic therapy for psoriasis within 12 weeks before Baseline.
Added PSQ-5 (licensed patient-reported outcome) at Baseline and Week 12.
Week 4 visit may be conducted remotely at the investigator's discretion.

eligibilityCriteria.text: Diagnosis of plaque psoriasis for at least 6 months before Baseline.
Body surface area (BSA) involvement of at least 10% at Screening.
Pregnant or breastfeeding (applies to participants of childbearing potential).
Active serious infection within 4 weeks before Baseline.
Prior biologic therapy for psoriasis within 12 weeks before Baseline.

activities.name: PSQ-5 Pruritus Symptom Questionnaire (licensed; item text supplied by licensor, not in protocol)
